say:1:1122501001:1.text: You came just in time. You remember those Quicksand Claws, don't you? There's another bounty on them in town.
say:1:1122501001:1.source_cn: 你来得正好。你还记得那群流沙之爪吧？镇上又有人悬赏他们。
say:1:1122501001:1.male: You came just in time. You remember those Quicksand Claws, don't you? There's another bounty on them in town.
say:1:1122501001:1.female: You came just in time. You remember those Quicksand Claws, don't you? There's another bounty on them in town.

say:2:1122501002:1.text: But these Claws are sharp. It's been days, and only <style="highlight">one merchant staying at the inn</style> has seen them.
say:2:1122501002:1.source_cn: 不过这伙流沙之爪很敏锐，藏得也隐蔽。都好几天了，只有一...

say:3:1122501003:1.text: People have tried asking him for information, but he hasn't said a word. They say he's a little strange and that the Claws may be paying him to keep his mouth shut.
say:3:1122501003:1.source_cn: 不少人都去找他打听过，但这个人脾气古怪，好像又收了流沙...

say:4:1122501004:1.text: Unfortunately, it's inconvenient for me to go in person. So, I'll need you to go and try to pry some information out of him.
say:4:1122501004:1.source_cn: 可惜我不方便亲自出面，打探情报的事，只能交给你了。
say:4:1122501004:1.male: Unfortunately, it's inconvenient for me to go in person. So, I'll need you to go and try to pry some information out of him.
say:4:1122501004:1.female: Unfortunately, it's inconvenient for me to go in person. So, I'll need you to go and try to pry some information out of him.

say:1:1122502001:1.text: Here we go again... You're here to ask about the Quicksand Claws, aren't you? This is so bloody annoying.
say:1:1122502001:1.source_cn: 又是来打听流沙之爪的，唉，真烦。

say:2:1122502002:1.text: How about this? If you can beat me in Century Quest, I'll share a little something.
say:2:1122502002:1.source_cn: 要是百物牌玩得比我还好，我就告诉你！
say:2:1122502002:1.male: How about this? If you can beat me in Century Quest, I'll share a little something.
say:2:1122502002:1.female: How about this? If you can beat me in Century Quest, I'll share a little something.

say:0:1122503001:0.text: Alright, you got me. The Claws headed <style="highlight">south of Alkali</style>.
say:0:1122503001:0.source_cn: 行吧行吧，愿赌服输。流沙之爪往<style=highl...

say:1:1122503002:0.text: But I don't know if they'll still be around once you head there.
say:1:1122503002:0.source_cn: 嘿……就是不知道你们现在过去，他们还在不在了。

say:0:1122504001:0.text: Give us a break! Rufus made us do all those things!
say:0:1122504001:0.source_cn: 饶了我们吧！那些事都是鲁弗斯让我们做的！

say:1:1122504002:0.text: He knew that merchant couldn't be trusted, so he hid himself in <style="highlight">the hills north of Alkali</style>!
say:1:1122504002:0.source_cn: 他、他猜到那个商人嘴巴不严，就自己躲到<style=h...

say:1:1122505002:0.text: Those bloody fursacks! I can't believe they betrayed me!
say:1:1122505002:0.source_cn: 可恶，那帮不中用的家伙，居然敢出卖我！

say:2:1122506002:1.text: You really are something. I knew I was right about you.
say:2:1122506002:1.source_cn: 哈……真不愧是你啊，我果然没看走眼。
say:2:1122506002:1.male: You really are something. I knew I was right about you.
say:2:1122506002:1.female: You really are something. I knew I was right about you.

say:3:1122506003:1.text: You're almost as good as I am. Hahaha!
say:3:1122506003:1.source_cn: 这干脆利落的劲头，也就只比我差一点吧，哈哈哈！
say:3:1122506003:1.male: You're almost as good as I am. Hahaha!
say:3:1122506003:1.female: You're almost as good as I am. Hahaha!
